description: This file is a CMake script configuring the integration of NCCL (a GPU communication library) into a build system. It manages finding existing NCCL installations or building NCCL from source, sets up dependencies, and configures link and include directories.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for the specified package, in this case NCCL.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an interface library for NCCL integration, facilitating link and include configurations.

methods.name: target_link_libraries
methods.description: Specifies libraries to link against the target interface library.

methods.name: target_include_directories
methods.description: Adds include directories for the interface library.

methods.name: ExternalProject_Add
methods.description: Defines an external project to build NCCL from source if not found in the system.
